items.title: Week 6 Thursday recap: winners, surprises and waiver adds
items.dek: Who won your Thursday, who disappointed, and who to grab off waivers, from the box scores.
body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR, SEA): 25.4 points on 12 catches on 16 targets, 134 yds, against a projection of 18.2.
RJ Harvey (RB, DEN): 14.6 points on 6 carries, 25 yds, 1 TD; 3 catches on 4 targets, 31 yds, against a projection of 9.2.
J.K. Dobbins (RB, DEN): 13.6 points on 17 carries, 41 yds, 1 TD; 3 catches on 3 targets, 5 yds, against a projection of 9.3.
Cooper Kupp (WR, SEA): 10.0 points on 5 catches on 10 targets, 50 yds, against a projection of 5.8.
Rashid Shaheed (WR, SEA): 9.8 points on 1 carry, 2 yds; 5 catches on 8 targets, 66 yds, against a projection of 6.5.
Sam Darnold (QB, SEA): 9.0 points on 27/51, 278 yds, 2 INT; 2 carries, 19 yds, against a projection of 13.5.
Bo Nix fell 9.4 short of his 13.9-point projection with 4.5.
Jaxon Smith-Njigba drew 16 targets, the kind of volume that holds up even in quieter weeks.
Cooper Kupp drew 10 targets, the kind of volume that holds up even in quieter weeks.
Next up: Jaxon Smith-Njigba projects for 18.1 in week 7 against the Chiefs; RJ Harvey projects for 9.5 in week 7 against the Cardinals; J.K. Dobbins projects for 10.5 in week 7 against the Cardinals.
Projections for next week update with the next data run, and BFF value, rankings and trade values follow.
